jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Seqera exists to make complex scientific data analysis accessible at any scale. Empowering scientists with modern software engineering for data analysis

We provide software for scientists solving today's most complex and important challenges from pioneering innovative therapeutics to unveiling the secrets of our universe. The journey began a decade ago with Nextflow — open software that helps over 100,000 global scientists analyze and process data, with more power and flexibility than ever before.

Today, Seqera consolidates fragmented data and diverse computing resources into a unified platform. Our modern biotech stack is trusted by over 150 leading life sciences organizations. Empowered with modern software engineering, organizations conduct science faster, on larger datasets, and with more confidence. Seqera accelerates discoveries in an open world.

Would you like to be a part of a company with a bigger purpose and make it successful with your own ideas? If yes, keep... reading!

About the role

We're expanding our DevOps team to accommodate the rapid expansion of our Engineering department. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll be instrumental in not only shaping our infrastructure but also defining the future of engineering enablement within the company. You’ll do the usual DevOps things, ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems.

Collaborating closely with our engineering and support teams, you'll streamline development processes, optimize deployment pipelines, and fortify our continuous integration and delivery practices. Your role will encompass managing our cloud infrastructure, enhancing our observability capabilities, simplifying security protocols, and driving automation initiatives.

We're seeking a talented individual who excels in dynamic environments, relishes new challenges, and is deeply committed to helping engineers do their best work with amazing tooling.

What You'll Do
• Design, implement, and manage cloud-based infrastructure on AWS.
• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate software deployment, testing, and release processes.
• Enable our software engineers to independently develop, release and maintain software via close collaboration with and education of the engineering team.
• Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure the reliability and performance of our applications and services.
• Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform and related tools.
• Evaluate, recommend, and lead implementation of new tools and technologies to improve efficiency, scalability, and security.
• Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related issues in production and non-production environments.
• Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

About you
• You have proven experience in designing and implementing cloud solutions, preferably in AWS/Azure/GCP (nice to have: at least 2 out of 3).
• You know a lot about Linux and are capable of working with bash.
• You’re really very good with Docker and general container concepts and its toolset ecosystem.
• You are an expert when it comes to Infrastructure As Code, CI/CD, and other modern tooling to accelerate engineering processes. You’re proficient in tooling for these (such as Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.) and have experience working with them in an enterprise setting.
• You are proficient in Monitoring and observability tooling and techniques across a broad swath of concerns including security, performance, networking and provenance.
• You are a fast learner and are able to navigate across multiple functions and complex systems.
• You are able to work both independently and as part of a team. You strive to drive collaboration, and decision making and have deep opinions on platform design.
• Strong proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages, with the ability to mentor others on best practices.
• You have experience in identifying and responding to complex incidents, including issues that may relate to customer infrastructure.

Nice to have:
• Product development life cycle and tools that allow engineers to build cool stuff faster and more easily.
• Cloud networking minutiae: designing and implementing network architectures in cloud environments, hybrid network environments, facility with Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Virtual Network (VNets), and load balancing
• Cloud security, especially for AWS( IAM, secure configuration of services, AWS Cloudtrail, SCP’s, AWS Org, Config etc.)
• Life in a rapidly growing startup, stories about the struggles you’ve seen during rapid growth, and solutions you’ve helped craft for them.
• Working with open source communities, extra points if you’ve helped commercialise an OSS project.
• Technical writing, and the ability to explain complex topics in simple terms.
• Understanding the whole solution, not just the technology, evaluate tradeoffs, and communicate decisions to colleagues with a variety of backgrounds.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Seqera, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role and your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

What will you find working at Seqera?
• Flexible working hours and remote-friendly culture.
• International working environment with more than 25 nationalities.
• Passionate & talented team.
• Continuous skills development.
• Team retreats and bonding activities.
• A culture where your opinion is valued and your decisions have a real impact on the industry.
• Excitement of a fast-growing startup in a constantly changing environment.

Great benefits
• Time off: 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December of 2024, and the national/public holidays according to your location.
• Equity
• Private health insurance
• Private life insurance
• Home office allowance (valued over 1,000 USD)
• Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
• Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)

You should know

Seqera is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them. Come join us and help us build a global company that everyone is proud to be part of.

As we scale, we constantly improve our in-office and WFH environments and learn to help everyone have the best setup for our company's success and your personal development while always keeping the human touch in every aspect of our lives.

Why join us?

By learning from and with each other, we ensure our ability to drive innovation and make better decisions toward our mission. Most importantly, our culture provides a genuinely fun, inclusive, and challenging environment that will allow you to grow while making a huge difference in human health and beyond

jobs_results.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Cloud DevOps Engineer (AWS)

Description -

The Company

HP is a Fortune 100 technology company with $58+ Billion in revenue, with over 50,000 employees operating in more than 170 countries around the world. We provide technology and services that help people and companies address their problems and challenges, and realize their possibilities, aspirations and dreams. We apply new thinking and ideas to create simpler, more valuable and trusted experiences with technology, continuously improving the way our customers live and work.

Position background

In the GTM analytics COE our mission is to deliver impact by building machine learning products to optimize pricing and marketing investments and provide guidance to our sales organization.

Within the Cloud Infrastructure team, we are ensuring that our Data Science teams have all the technology assets they need to perform their duties and that our Big Data environment is secure and has an up time of 99.99999%.

As a Cloud Engineer you... will contribute to the success of our team thru the development of new automation and maintenance of existing ones for which you will ensure their compliance with security policies. As well you will help maintain and deploy infrastructure elements.

We offer an international experience, collaborative culture, top rate experience in AI and ML and opportunity to create significant real-world impact.

What you will do
• Build internal services and systems with embedded automation.
• Enhance and maintain existing services.
• Create platform agnostic services.
• Create, maintain and monitor cloud infrastructure elements.
• Identify and automate manual processes.
• Implement monitoring tools using Grafana, Prometheus, ELK or similar.
• Participate in DevOps Game Day events.
• Assist with and own remediation of escalated security events and incidents.
• Participate in Cyber Security Reviews and ensure compliance with the privacy office recommendations.
• Implementation Security and Compliance Policies and Standards, Disaster Recovery Plans, Data and Information Backup and Recovery Guidelines.

What you will need:
• Bachelor’s in computer engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field
• 2+ years on a similar role.
• Ability to work under pressure as well as in autonomous mode.
• You have strong problem-solving skills and you can lead complex projects.
• Experience operating cloud-based infrastructures (AWS).
• Experience with modern application lifecycle management tools (Git, Visual Studio, Intellij, Code Reviews).
• Experience with container orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS EKS
• Experience with IaC frameworks such as Terraform, Cloud Formation, Ansible, Puppet.
• Work experience in CI/CD environments
• Experience with Linux Operating Systems
• Proficient in at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, Node.js, Bash, Go.
• Experience in working with AWS services such as IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, S3, EC2, VPC, RDS.
• Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability.
• Experience in deploying REST API services.
• Experience in maintaining the security of cloud environments (AWS).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills directed to technical and non-technical team members.

Nice to have:
• Experience with Could SQL & NoSQL databases.
• Solid knowledge of cyber security standards and frameworks.
• Experience on implementing disaster recovery solutions.

Who We Are

At HP, we believe in the power of ideas. We use ideas to put technology to work for everyone. And we believe that ideas thrive best in a culture of teamwork. That is why everyone – at every level in every function, is encouraged to think big, have original ideas and express and share them. We trust anything can be achieved if you really believe in it, and we will invest in your ideas to change lives and the way people work. This vision is what sets us apart as a company. At HP, we work across borders and without limits. Global virtual teams share resources, pool their big ideas to solve our biggest business opportunities. Everyone is valued for the unique skills, experiences and perspective they bring. That’s how we work at HP. And this is how ideas and people grow.

Job -
Software

Schedule -
Full time

Shift -
No shift premium (Spain)

Travel -

Relocation -

Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) -

HP, Inc. provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and prospective employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, age, disability, or status as a protected veteran, marital status, familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic predisposition or carrier status, uniformed service status, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by applicable national, federal, state, and local law(s).

Please be assured that you will not be subject to any adverse treatment if you choose to disclose the information requested. This information is provided voluntarily. The information obtained will be kept in strict confidence.

jobs_results.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Join a team that is changing millions of lives.

Transforming smiles, changing lives

 

At Align Technology, we believe a great smile can transform a person’s life, so we create technology that gives people the confidence to take on whatever’s next. We revolutionized the orthodontic industry with the introduction of the Invisalign system, and we have never lost sight of that spirit of innovation. Our diverse and collaborative teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 

Ready to join us? 

About this opportunity

Align is expanding its team in Madrid, Spain. This energetic and highly technical team is responsible for creating the next generation of our operational platform infrastructure to expedite the development and delivery of software in the digital medical device space. We work closely with engineering teams to become highly efficient and autonomous by providing automated solutions wherever practical. This is a great opportunity to combine the latest... tools and technologies with cutting-edge approaches to build the best development platform in the industry.

We are looking for a candidate for the Operations Services team. We are an integrational team. Our responsibilities include the development of API Services on Java Spring. The services provide access to backend systems in Amazon Cloud. Backend systems include ML models and file processing components on C++ etc. The team consists of Java developers, DevOps and SQA.

In this role, you will…

This individual contributor role will need to keep up to date with all modern technologies in the field of cloud infrastructure operations and release engineering (often referred to as “devops”). That skill set will be applied across the following activities:
• Collaborate with development teams on implementing deployment and packaging automation for their apps using Docker, CloudFormation, Terraform, kubernetes, or other appropriate technologies
• Participate in strategic projects to improve Align’s approach to cloud-based infrastructure and application deployment
• Develop solutions to automate repetitive tasks, monitor system health, create and update real-time inventories and reports, and improve existing processes
• Participate in shaping and improving SDLC processes and document them in Standard Operating Procedures

In this role, you’ll need …
• Proficiency in speaking and writing English
• Masters or Bachelors in Computer Science or equivalent experience
• 2+ years working in a cloud (AWS preferred)
• 5+ years working on systems admin level with Linux and/or Windows
• Experience with any of docker orchestration tools (K8S, Docker Swarm, Rancher)
• Experience working with configuration and/or infrastructure management frameworks (Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)
• Familiarity with modern container technologies
• Experience deploying, troubleshooting, and maintaining distributed systems and/or client-server applications
• Strong skills in one or more of the following programming languages: Python
• Ability to learn quickly

Sound like a good fit? 

 

Great! Click the "Apply" link to let us know you are interested. Not the right fit? Don’t worry, Align is quickly growing so we are creating more opportunities to expand our Align family. Please consider joining our Talent Network to receive notifications about future jobs or sharing this opportunity with others in your network.    

 

About Align  

  

Align Technology is a publicly traded medical device company that is transforming smiles and changing lives. Our global team of talented employees develop innovative technology, tools and treatment options to help dental professionals worldwide achieve the clinical results they expect. Our digital ecosystem combines the power of technology to create beautiful smiles through the integration of AI and machine learning, digital imaging and visualization, biomechanics and material science to develop the Invisalign system, the most advanced clear aligner system in the world; iTero Intraoral Scanners and OrthoCAD digital services. Did you know? Align is the world’s largest manufacturer of custom 3D-printed materials.   

  

By joining Align, you will be part of a global, fast-growing company in one of the most dynamic industries. Great people, innovative technologies, and meaningful work – these are just some of the things employees say make Align Technology a great place to work.   

  

We respect your privacy. Please review our Applicant Privacy Policies for additional information.  

 

Global Diversity Statement:

At Align, we believe in the power of a smile, and we know that every smile is as unique as our employees. As we grow, we will continue building a workforce of diverse cultural backgrounds and life experiences and fostering a culture of open-mindedness and compassion for all our employees. We live our company values by promoting healthy people and healthy communities. All with the intent of changing millions of lives, one unique smile at a time.

Equal Opportunity Statement

It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity in all of our employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Applicants for positions with Align must be legally authorized to work in the country which they are applying for and verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire.

#LI-YM1

#LI-Hybrid

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure IOT Cloud) (d/f/m)
jobs_results.company_name: TK ELEVATOR IBERICA HOLDING, SL UNIPERSONAL
jobs_results.description:
People are at the center of everything we do at TK Elevator – we work as one team, watch out for each other’s safety and share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your chance to go beyond and impact the future of urban mobility. We are looking for talented people who want to start or develop their professional career with us.

With integrated cloud-based solutions such as our MAX platform, we embrace the full potential of digitalization, transforming ourselves into a digitally augmented company to make life easier, more efficient and more comfortable.

TK Elevator aims to be a leader in industrial IoT solutions, data enabled solutions software solutions that make our customers and users successful and happy. Jointly with leading technology companies as strategic partners, we have just released our first Digital Native Elevator EOX. We will continue this journey - to improve the lives of people everywhere, every day.

You will co-drive this journey with a dynamic and... growing team that uses leading technology and works in a truly global setup to solve challenging problems, develop new business solutions and digital products.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer specializing in Azure in IoT and data solutions. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless operation and reliability of our MAX IoT Platform. As a Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer, you will support maintaining Azure-based IoT solutions, providing scalability, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring other members of the team.

jobs_results.description:
DevOps ManagerLocation: Barcelona

This is what you will do:

The DevOps Manager will be a key role in the Digital team. This individual will be the Service Delivery Manager and subject matter expert for DevSecOps projects and operations. The Candidate will promote and champion DevOps practices at Alexion and help enable the tools required to set up CI/CD pipelines.

You will be responsible for:
• Establishing stable, secure and scalable DevOps infrastructureEnsuring timely and effective responses to DevOps related incidents
• Analyzing IT and business processes to identify DevOps opportunities
• Driving the adoption and continuous refinement of DevOps methodologies and tools
• Leading the end to end delivery of DevOps solutions
• Leading partner resources and their outcome
• Maintaining an uptodate understanding of emerging trends and technologies in the DevOps space and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
• Promoting standardization and best practices for version... control, build artifacts and deployment.

You will need to have:
• Minimum 4 years of experienceBachelor/Master in Information Technology
• Deep knowledge of cloud platformsDeep knowledge of DevOps components and toolsHandson experience implementing DevOps infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines
• Strong analytical and communication skills
• Ability to collaborate across teams and be a standout colleague
• Ability to work independently and quickly absorb new technologies

We would prefer for you to have:
• Deep knowledge specific to the following platforms and tools both in Cloud and privately deployed versions or offerings: GitHub, Jenkins, Kubernetes, AWS, EKSCertifications in cloud platforms, DevOps, or related areas.
• Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare and life sciences industry.
• Knowledge of best practices and regulations related to data security and privacy in the healthcare sector.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Overview

About us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world's most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
About the role

Are you a DevOps Engineer looking to make a meaningful impact... in the renewable energy industry? Embrace this opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with a team of skilled professionals. Join our green revolution! Apply now to be at the heart of it.

What to expect?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, implementation, and maintenance of our infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring reliability and scalability of our applications, optimizing our deployment processes, and using properly our resources.

Your day to day will include:
• Develop and implement strategies for infrastructure management, CI/CD, and cloud operations,
• Guide technically the implementation of network security and policies,
• Coordinate with other departments to understand their needs and provide solutions,
• Stay update with the latest trends and technologies, and apply this knowledge to improve processes and tools,
• Manage budgets and licenses related to DevOps tools and services,
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the team.

This role presents an exciting opportunity to join a growing team, with the possibility for individuals to take on leadership roles and expand their responsibilities to lead a small team in the future.

The team awaiting you

You will join a dynamic team dedicated to ensuring the reliable and secure operation of our cutting-edge GPM products and maintaining the robustness and scalability of the IT infrastructure, ultimately enhancing efficiency. We work together to design and manage a scalable and dynamic infrastructure that seamlessly integrates both on-site and cloud solutions, embracing the latest technological advancement.

Our team is at the forefront of driving automation enhancements, integrating advanced monitoring tools and practices. We uphold a high-availability service framework, meticulously develop and test disaster recovery plans, and ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and requirements. Embracing a working culture built on continuous improvement, security awareness, resilience, and scalability, we invite you to be a part of our journey towards excellence.

GreenPowerMonitor and Solutions (GPM&S) is at the heart of the global energy transformation. We use data-driven digital solutions to optimise the performance of renewable energy installations around the world. Our work contributes to a more diverse, more sustainable global energy mix.

What we offer

Our benefits package is specifically designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being:
• Great atmosphere of working together with professionals and some of the most engaged and knowledgeable people in the industry.
• Receive guidance from colleagues through coaching, mentoring and participating in international networks.
• Advance your professional skills and technical expertise, through individual competence development plans and tailored training.
• Be part of a world growing and renowned organization with origins dating back to 1864.

Other than that you can expect:
• Medical Scheme
• Commuting Allowance
• Life Insurance
• Pension Plan
• Kindergarten Allowance
• 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule
• Home working allowance (up to 2 days per week)
• 23 days of annual leave
• Employee Referral scheme.
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
About you

Which skills to bring?

To thrive and succeed, we expect you to have:
• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration, including experience in deploying and scaling containers in production environments
• Proven experience in Azure Devops, Terraform, Kubernetes, Calico and Kubeflow
• Strong leadership skills and experience managing a technical team
• Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills
• Familiarity with agile methodologies and fast-paced work environment
• Fluent in English and Spanish.

And if youve got these in your back pocket, consider it a bonus:
• Experience implementing and managing robust, high-available architectures
• Knowledge in infrastructure and application security
• Knowledge in relational and non-relational dbms.

Which skills to bring?

To thrive and succeed, we expect you to have:
• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration, including experience in deploying and scaling containers in production environments
• Proven experience in Azure Devops, Terraform, Kubernetes, Calico and Kubeflow
• Strong leadership skills and experience managing a technical team
• Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills
• Familiarity with agile methodologies and fast-paced work environment
• Fluent in English and Spanish.

And if youve got these in your back pocket, consider it a bonus:
• Experience implementing and managing robust, high-available architectures
• Knowledge in infrastructure and application security
• Knowledge in relational and non-relational dbms

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer | Azure
jobs_results.description:
Be a pioneer!

We want to extend our engineering capabilities and utilize DevOps tools and methods to automate testing and integration processes. That's why we are starting to build a DevOps team and you may become it's first member.

This gives you a unique opportunity to shape a long-term DevOps strategy, define processes, implement tools and guide young an aspiring engineers, using state of the art resources. For this, you work directly with our CTO and are integrated into our product development team of 20 engineers.

Benefits
• Permanent contract with a competitive salary.
• Yearly reviews, target agreements & salary increase.
• Private health insurance, paid trainings, team events and other benefits.
• Work in a modern and agile environment with state-of-the-art tools.
• Work partially or completely at home or at any other suitable place.
• Be part of a multi-cultural, talented, and ambitious team.
• Take advantage of career opportunities in a growing company.

Your Role
•... Design DevOps strategies, methods and workflows.
• Select and implement devops tools and resources.
• Provide knowledge and tools to other engineers.
• Contribute to improving efficiency and security.
• Set up metrics to measure our DevOps efforts.

Your Skills
• Extensive professional experience as a DevOps engineer.
• Profound knowledge of the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
• Preferably good knowledge of security and data protection.
• Eager to take responsibility in an agile and challenging team.
• Fluent in English, both spoken and written (B2+).

About us

For over 25 years, hundreds of companies at thousands of locations all over Europe rely on our ever-evolving solutions and platforms to integrate their infrastructure, connect with their business partners, and transform and exchange their data. We process millions of business-critical documents each year – like orders, invoices, product catalogues, inventory, and price data.

Our next big leap is to build a unique Business Intelligence and Automation Platform. We call it FXM – Feedback & Experience Management. It utilizes vast amounts of industry data to provide real-time and easy-to-use reports for business leaders. This enables them to get unique insights and make critical business decisions putting them ahead of their competition.

Visit career.integrated-worlds.com to learn more. We look forward to meeting you
